body.name: positive order-four tensor Jackson approximation
body.construction: For integer \(K_d\geq2\), let \(J_{K_d}(t)=c_{K_d}[\sin(K_dt/2)/\sin(t/2)]^4\) on \([-\pi,\pi]\), with removable values filled continuously and \(c_{K_d}\) chosen so that \(\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}J_{K_d}(t)\,dt=1\). For a rectangle \(Q_x=\prod_{\jmath\in\mathcal J}[\ell_{\jmath,x},u_{\jmath,x}]\) with center \(b_{\jmath,x}=(\ell_{\jmath,x}+u_{\jmath,x})/2\) and radius \(r_{\jmath,x}=(u_{\jmath,x}-\ell_{\jmath,x})/2\), define \(P_{x,K_d}\) by the even product convolution \(P_{x,K_d}(b_x+r_x\odot\cos\theta)=\int_{[-\pi,\pi]^4}\bar f_\epsilon(b_x+r_x\odot\cos(\theta+t))\prod_{\jmath\in\mathcal J}J_{K_d}(t_{\jmath})\,dt\).
